explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Corvale General holds 210 units of divalproex sodium with 26 days on hand at current use.
The product label names Coupler LLC as the registered plant for this NDC.
FDA inspection 1049813 at Coupler LLC ended on 2018-04-27 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2018-07-26.
FDA inspection 1120463 at the same plant ended on 2020-03-10 and was also classified OAI, known on 2020-06-08.
A Warning Letter was issued to Coupler LLC on 2020-09-15 following those inspections.
FDA inspection 1148607 ended on 2021-08-12 and was classified OAI, known on 2021-11-10.
The most recent inspection 1308780 ended on 2026-03-02 and was classified VAI, known on 2026-05-27.

Q-ff96d9.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%divalproex%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%divalproex%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-baa88c.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('4834732f-6044-946c-e063-6394a90a5da3') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-a0cb74.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%divalproex%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-089bd6.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%divalproex%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-867a28.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%divalproex%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-3bc28d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3003734940') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-6a9573.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3003734940') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-fdef10.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3003734940') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('coupler')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-1802a1.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('coupler') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%divalproex%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-fc0119.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1049813', '1120463', '1148607') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-abadad.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('67046164703')

Q-4c573b.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%divalproex%'
